general.notes: Operating temperature is 0°C to +70°C for TQ2025-TUNC-SO and -40°C to +85°C for TQ2025-TUNI-SO. Power consumption <5.5W (TUNC) and <6.0W (TUNI); Extended mode adds 0.2W when set in Low Power mode. Typical reach 80km unamplified (footnote 1 power budget), 120km amplified (footnote 2 dispersion compensation), 300km amplified extended mode (footnote 3). Dispersion tolerance ±2400ps/nm and ±6000ps/nm (footnote 3). Rx sensitivity footnotes: 4) Average power; 5) unamplified OSNR >35dB/0.1nm with 100G DQPSK SC-FEC; 6) OSNR tolerance 16.5 dB/0.1nm; 7) 100G DQPSK RS-FEC, -24.0dBm sensitivity, 21.5 dB/0.1nm OSNR; 8) Extended range amplified -22dBm with <1dB OSNR penalty relative to Rx OSNR tolerance limit. Alternate CMIS version p/n TQ2028-TUNx-SO per SFF-8636. Power budget 0–22dB. Chromatic dispersion values stated with ± prefix.
